pairs: Factum est autem,
Then it happened that,
cum complesset Jeremias loquens ad populum universos sermones Domini Dei eorum,
when Jeremiah had finished speaking all the words of the Lord their God to the people,
pro quibus miserat eum Dominus Deus eorum ad illos, omnia verba hæc,
all those words concerning which the Lord their God had sent him to them,
dixit Azarias filius Osaiæ,
Azariah, the son of Hoshaiah,
et Johanan filius Caree,
and Johanan, the son of Kareah,
et omnes viri superbi,
and all the exalted men,
dicentes ad Jeremiam:
spoke to Jeremiah, saying:
Mendacium tu loqueris:
“You are speaking a lie!
non misit te Dominus Deus noster,
The Lord our God has not sent you to say:
dicens: Ne ingrediamini Ægyptum ut habitetis illuc.
‘You shall not enter into Egypt so as to live in that place.’
Sed Baruch filius Neriæ incitat te adversum nos, ut tradat nos in manus Chaldæorum, ut interficiat nos, et traduci faciat in Babylonem.
Instead, Baruch, the son of Neriah, has incited you against us, so as to deliver us into the hands of the Chaldeans, to put us to death and to cause us to be led away into Babylon.”
Et non audivit Johanan filius Caree,
And so Johanan,
et omnes principes bellatorum,
the son of Kareah,
et universus populus,
and all the leaders of the warriors,
vocem Domini,
and all the people,
ut manerent in terra Juda.
did not heed the voice of the Lord to remain in the land of Judah.
Sed tollens Johanan filius Caree,
But Johanan,
et universi principes bellatorum,
the son of Kareah,
universos reliquiarum Juda,
and all the leaders of the warriors,
qui reversi fuerant de cunctis gentibus ad quas fuerant ante dispersi,
took away all the remnant of Judah,
ut habitarent in terra Juda,
who had returned from all the nations (to which they had been scattered before) to live in the land of Judah:
viros, et mulieres, et parvulos, et filias regis, et omnem animam quam reliquerat Nabuzardan princeps militiæ cum Godolia filio Ahicam filii Saphan, et Jeremiam prophetam, et Baruch filium Neriæ:

men, and women, and children, and the daughters of the king, and every soul that Nebuzaradan, the leader of the military, had left behind with Gedaliah, the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as well as Jeremiah, the prophet, and Baruch, the son of Neriah.
et ingressi sunt terram Ægypti,
And they entered into the land of Egypt.
quia non obedierunt voci Domini,
For they did not obey the voice of the Lord.
et venerunt usque ad Taphnis.
And they went as far as Tahpanhes.
Et factus est sermo Domini ad Jeremiam in Taphnis,
And the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah at Tahpanhes,
dicens:
saying:
Sume lapides grandes in manu tua,
“Take great stones in your hand,
et abscondes eos in crypta quæ est sub muro latericio in porta domus Pharaonis in Taphnis,
and you shall conceal them in the crypt which is under the brick wall at the gate of the house of Pharaoh at Tahpanhes,
cernentibus viris Judæis:
in the sight of the men of Judah.
et dices ad eos: Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum,
And you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord of hosts,
Deus Israël:
the God of Israel:
Ecce ego mittam et assumam Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis,
Behold, I will send for and take Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon,
servum meum:
my servant,
et ponam thronum ejus super lapides istos quos abscondi,
and I will set his throne over these stones which I have concealed,
et statuet solium suum super eos:
and he will establish his throne upon them.
veniensque percutiet terram Ægypti,
And he will come and strike the land of Egypt:
quos in mortem,
those who are meant for death,
in mortem,
shall go to death,
et quos in captivitatem,
and those for captivity,
in captivitatem,
to captivity,
et quos in gladium,
and those for the sword,
in gladium:
to the sword.
et succendet ignem in delubris deorum Ægypti,
And he will kindle a fire in the shrines of the gods of Egypt,
et comburet ea,
and he will burn them down,
et captivos ducet illos,
and he will lead them away captive.
et amicietur terra Ægypti sicut amicitur pastor pallio suo,
And he will clothe himself with the land of Egypt, just as a shepherd is clothed with his cloak.
et egredietur inde in pace:
And he will go forth from that place in peace.
et conteret statuas domus solis quæ sunt in terra Ægypti,
And he will crush the statues of the house of the Sun, those that are in the land of Egypt,
et delubra deorum Ægypti comburet igni.
and the shrines of the gods of Egypt he will burn up with fire.”
